entries.dialogueText: "And your subjects would rather we roll over in submission to the Palesians and their greedy puppetmasters?"

entries.dialogueText: "If I am sending my people to fight for a cause they do not fully believe in, that's indeed troubling."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand that, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "There must surely have been a middle ground between that and outright war. But it is now too late to find it."

entries.dialogueText: "In this way, we can ensure continued funding for our domestic programs, including care for our veterans, in spite of the heavy costs of the war effort."

entries.dialogueText: "Even if we needed the money... these are the same industries that have been working tirelessly to supply our troops with weapons and equipment. They should be lauded, not penalized."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Keep in mind that these are the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep in mind that these are the same industries that have been working tirelessly to supply our troops with weapons and equipment. They should be lauded, not penalized."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As I was saying. Now that we are e..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I was saying. Now that we are engaged in this unfortunate conflict, measures must be taken to mitigate its impact on ordinary citizens."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If we are to remain engaged in thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we are to remain engaged in this unfortunate conflict, measures must be taken to mitigate its impact on ordinary citizens."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It is a simple fact that war is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a simple fact that war is a source of suffering for many and enormous financial windfalls for an elite few."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""In the name of equity, the RPP is..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the name of equity, the RPP is proposing an excess profits tax on the businesses and industries that stand to generate the most revenue from the Pales campaign."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""If we need funding, we can get it..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we need funding, we can get it another way. The companies in question should be lauded for their contribution to the cause, not penalized."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""And even if that wasn't the case,..."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You are misrepresenting our propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are misrepresenting our proposal, Madam Speaker."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It is an undeniable fact that war..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is an undeniable fact that war is a source of suffering for many and enormous financial windfalls for an elite few."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""What we are proposing is a move to..."
entries.dialogueText: "What we are proposing is a move towards equity. It is not fair that our military operation will put a strain on social welfare while fattening the pockets of weapons executives."
